title: C DIO Time codec tests omit null buffer and malformed iterator boundaries
description: Robustness review of the new rpl_messages host test found missing acceptance cases for NULL inputs, short output buffer, canonical NO_SYNC, an option header without length, and a TLV whose declared length overruns the option list. Add exact error assertions and verify failed serialization does not modify the output buffer.
notes: Returned open/unclaimed because the user explicitly excluded C/Zephyr/AWS work from this session; no C changes from this finding remain.
